title: Cosmo: a words-only clip runs on an installed H3 reference model, not a MiniMax H3 install
description: Live on a Pod with only Singularity H3: a talking-head text-to-video ask got a 21.4 GB MiniMax H3 install offer. ref2v_ms with no references is a plain t2v run (docs/models/h3/ref2va.md), but list_models never said so, and installedKin skipped Singularity (no modelFamily).
